summary: Iteration 6 — Header redesign (solid sticky navy, no transparent-over-hero) verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 5/5 pass. Frontend all 14 requested assertions GREEN.
critical_code_review_comments: Nav.jsx line 35 uses border-b border-[color:var(--paper)]/12 — Tailwind arbitrary opacity class /12 is non-standard (only /10, /20 etc are canonical); it appears to still resolve but computed color came back as rgb(229,231,235) (default gray-200) rather than a paper-tinted border. Not user-visible but cleaner to use /10 or /20 for portability.

Home hero uses calc(100svh - 100px). At mobile viewports header is 86px (not 100), so on <768px the hero has an extra 14px of blank space below it. Consider calc(100svh - 86px) with a md: override, or use CSS var --nav-h.
